title: 2022年12月四级真题 第3套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
passage:
P1 Research shows that in developed countries, more affluent and educated people tend to consume higher-quality diets—including more fruits and vegetables, fish and whole grains. On the contrary, economically disadvantaged people report diets that are nutrient-poor and energy-dense. They are less likely to have food-purchasing habits that conform to public health recommendations.

P2 These dietary differences are often accompanied by higher rates of obesity and diabetes among lower-income people. This relationship between social class and diet quality and health is extensively documented. However, the research does not explain why this is the case—a question that has significant implications for designing effective policies and initiatives to improve diets and prevent chronic diseases.

P3 Public-health initiatives to promote healthy diets often focus on providing nutrition education and recipes(食谱). These approaches, however, often presume less food literacy (i.e., food knowledge and skills) among low-income people. Are unhealthy diets really the result of poor choices, limited food skills and knowledge?

P4 Research suggests that adults in food-insecure households are just as likely as those in food- secure households to adjust recipes to make them more healthy. They are also just as proficient in food preparation and cooking skills. There is no indication that increasing food skills or budgeting skills will reduce food insecurity.

P5 Instead, disadvantaged groups are constrained by their economic, material and social circumstances. For example, low income is the strongest predictor of food insecurity in Canada, where one in eight households experiences insufficient access to nutritious foods.

P6 It's well-established that food prices are an important determinant of food choice. Low-income households report that they find it difficult to adopt dietary guidelines because food prices are a barrier to improving their diets.

P7 When researchers estimate the cost of diets people actually eat, higher-quality diets are typically more costly.

P8 While this may be so, it does not, in itself, prove that healthy diets are necessarily more expensive or cost-prohibitive. After all, not all socioeconomically disadvantaged people consume poor diets.

P9 We can easily think of a number of foods and recipes that are both inexpensive and nutritious. The internet is full of recipes for "eating well on a budget."

questions.q: What can we learn from research on diets in developed countries?
options: Dietary recommendations are not fit for underprivileged people.
People from different social groups vary in their dietary habits.
People's choice of food depends on their individual taste
There is no consensus on what high-quality diets are.
questions.explain:
【判型】What can we learn from research on diets in developed countries 没有 infer/imply 等 推断信号，问的是研究的客观结论。

【拆句】题干 What can we learn from research on diets in developed countries 是 What 引导 的特殊疑问句，主干是 What can we learn，后接介词短语 from research on diets in developed countries 修饰 learn 的来源；无从句、无否定、无陷阱。

【定位】Research shows that in developed countries, more affluent and educated people tend to consume higher-quality diets—including more fruits and vegetables, fish and whole grains. On the contrary, economically disadvantaged people report diets that are nutrient-poor and energy-dense. 研究表明，在发达国家，更富裕且受过良好教育的人倾向于消费更高质量的饮食——包括 更多水果蔬菜、鱼类和全谷物；相反，经济弱势人群所报告的饮食则是营养贫乏而能量密 集的。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 原文只说弱势群体 less likely to have food-purchasing habits that conform to public health recommendations，是"他们不照做"，并非 Dietary recommendations are not fit for underprivileged people 这种"建议本身不适合"。 B) ✓ 正确 more affluent and educated people tend to consume higher-quality diets ... On the contrary, economically disadvantaged people report diets that are nutrient-poor and energy-dense ↔People from different social groups vary in their dietary habits 预判中的"不同社会群体在饮食上存在差异"恰好被 People from different social groups vary in their dietary habits 直接覆盖，匹配度最高。 C) 无中生有 全段讨论的是阶级、收入、教育对饮食的影响，没有任何关于 individual taste 的 论述。 D) 无中生有 原文以列举 fruits and vegetables, fish and whole grains 等方式默认了高质量饮食的 内涵，没有讨论是否存在 consensus。 51. What can we learn from research on diets in developed countries? A) Dietary recommendations are not fit for underprivileged people. B) People from different social groups vary in their dietary habits. C) People's choice of food depends on their individual taste D) There is no consensus on what high-quality diets are. 作者认为在制定改善饮食和健康的政策时什么是重要的? A) 更好地理解社会阶层与健康之间的关系。 B) 更加重视研究肥胖和慢性疾病的成因。 C) 优先为较低阶层提供更好的营养。 D) 设计关于公共健康的教育项目和举措。

questions.q: What does the author say is important in formulating policies to improve diets and health?
options: A better understanding of the relationship between social class and health.
A greater emphasis on studying the cause of obesity and chronic diseases.
Prioritizing the provision of better nutrition for lower classes.
Designing education programs and initiatives on public health.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say is important 直接索取作者的明示判断，不是要考生自己 推断。

【拆句】题干 What does the author say is important in formulating policies to improve diets and health 是嵌套疑问句，主语 the author，谓语 say，宾语为省略 that 的从句 What ... is important in formulating policies，to improve diets and health 是不定式作目的状 语，结构清楚不绕。

【定位】However, the research does not explain why this is the case—a question that has significant implications for designing effective policies and initiatives to improve diets and prevent chronic diseases. 然而，研究并未解释"为何如此"——而这恰是一个对设计有效政策、推动饮食改善与慢病预 防具有重大意义的问题。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 the research does not explain why this is the case—a question that has significant implications for designing effective policies ↔A better understanding of the relationship between social class and health 预判的"弄清阶级与健康关系的成因"被 A better understanding of the relationship between social class and health 一句直接对应。 B) 以偏概全 原文谈的是 designing effective policies 的关键，是"理解关系成因"；选项却把焦点收 缩到 cause of obesity and chronic diseases，丢掉了"社会阶级"这一关键。 C) 偷换概念 原文强调政策制定需要先理解"为何如此"，并没有主张直接 Prioritizing the provision of better nutrition。 D) 张冠李戴 education programs and initiatives on public health 是第三段才出现的话题 nutrition education，且作者后文持质疑态度，并非他认定为政策制定的关键。 52. What does the author say is important in formulating policies to improve diets and health? A) A better understanding of the relationship between social class and health. B) A greater emphasis on studying the cause of obesity and chronic diseases. C) Prioritizing the provision of better nutrition for lower classes. D) Designing education programs and initiatives on public health. 研究揭示了食物不安全家庭中的成年人有什么特点? A) 他们的饮食习惯需要改变。 B) 他们的食物素养一直在提高。 C) 他们不太关注自己的食谱。 D) 他们并不缺乏食物知识或预算技能。

questions.q: What does research reveal about adults in food-insecure households?
options: Their eating habits need to be changed.
Their food literacy has been improving.
They do not pay much attention to their food recipes.
They do not lack food knowledge or budgeting skills.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does research reveal about adults in food-insecure households 问的是研究客观 结论，正确项是原文一句的同义改写。

【拆句】题干 What does research reveal about adults in food-insecure households 主干 research reveal，宾语为 What，about adults in food-insecure households 是宾语补足 的范围状语，限定研究对象，结构无陷阱。

【定位】Research suggests that adults in food-insecure households are just as likely as those in food- secure households to adjust recipes to make them more healthy. They are also just as proficient in food preparation and cooking skills. There is no indication that increasing food skills or budgeting skills will reduce food insecurity. 研究表明，食物不安全家庭的成年人，在调整食谱以使其更健康方面，与食物安全家庭的成 年人一样可能；他们在食物准备与烹饪技能上也同样熟练；没有迹象表明提升食物技能或预 算技能能减少食物不安全。

【选项】A) 与原文相反 原文整段都在论证"他们的饮食与烹饪并无问题"，Their eating habits need to be changed 反而把矛头指向他们的饮食习惯。 B) 无中生有 原文说他们"已经一样熟练"，并未谈到 has been improving 这种"正在提升"的进程。 C) 与原文相反 原文明确说他们 adjust recipes to make them more healthy，反而是在认真对待食 谱；do not pay much attention to their food recipes 与之相反。 D) ✓ 正确 just as proficient in food preparation and cooking skills ↔ They do not lack food knowledge or budgeting skills There is no indication that increasing food skills or budgeting skills will reduce food insecurity ↔They do not lack food knowledge or budgeting skills 预判中的"不缺食物知识与预算技能"与 They do not lack food knowledge or budgeting skills 是肯定—否定的等值改写。 53. What does research reveal about adults in food-insecure households? A) Their eating habits need to be changed. B) Their food literacy has been improving. C) They do not pay much attention to their food recipes. D) They do not lack food knowledge or budgeting skills. 什么有助于改善加拿大弱势群体的食物安全? A) 教他们预算技能。 B) 增加他们的食物选择。 C) 使他们能够更多地获得营养食品。 D) 采取更有效的措施来增加食物供应。

questions.q: What would help improve food security among the disadvantaged groups in Canada?
options: Teaching them budgeting skills.
Increasing their food choices.
Enabling them to have more access to nutritious foods.
Taking more effective measures to increase food supplies.
questions.explain:
【判型】What would help improve food security among the disadvantaged groups in Canada 问对应措施，原文应有明确陈述，不必推断。

【拆句】题干 What would help improve food security among the disadvantaged groups in Canada 主干 What would help improve food security，help 后省略 to，among the disadvantaged groups in Canada 是限定 food security 范围的介词短语，三层修饰但平 铺直叙。

【定位】For example, low income is the strongest predictor of food insecurity in Canada, where one in eight households experiences insufficient access to nutritious foods. 举例来说，在加拿大，低收入是食物不安全最强的预测因子，那里有八分之一的家庭无法充 分获取营养食物。

【选项】A) 与原文相反 第四段已明确 no indication that increasing food skills or budgeting skills will reduce food insecurity，作者直接驳斥 Teaching them budgeting skills 这种做法。 B) 偷换概念 原文谈的是 insufficient access to nutritious foods 即"获取渠道不足"，不是 Increasing their food choices 即"扩大可选范围"。 C) ✓ 正确 one in eight households experiences insufficient access to nutritious foods ↔ Enabling them to have more access to nutritious foods 预判中的"让他们更多获取营养食物"与 Enabling them to have more access to nutritious foods 一一对应。 D) 偷换概念 原文聚焦弱势人群的低收入与获取不足，并未主张 increase food supplies 这种宏观供 给端的对策。 54. What would help improve food security among the disadvantaged groups in Canada? A) Teaching them budgeting skills. B) Increasing their food choices. C) Enabling them to have more access to nutritious foods. D) Taking more effective measures to increase food supplies. 作者建议弱势群体做什么来改善健康? A) 对饮食指南采取积极态度。 B) 选择既健康又实惠的饮食。 C) 确保在互联网上购买健康食品。 D) 改变他们的饮食习惯和消费模式。

questions.q: What does the author suggest disadvantaged people do to improve their health?
options: Adopt a positive attitude towards dietary guidelines.
Choose diets that are both healthy and affordable.
Make sure to purchase healthy foods on the internet.
Change their eating habits and consumption patterns.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author suggest disadvantaged people do to improve their health 问 作者明示的建议，不是要考生跨段推断。

【拆句】题干 What does the author suggest disadvantaged people do to improve their health 是含 suggest 的特殊疑问句，宾语从句省略了 that 与 should，故 do 以原形出 现；to improve their health 是不定式目的状语，整体结构清晰。

【定位】We can easily think of a number of foods and recipes that are both inexpensive and nutritious. The internet is full of recipes for "eating well on a budget." 我们可以轻易想到一些既便宜又有营养的食物与食谱；互联网上充满了"在预算内吃得好"的 食谱。

【选项】A) 无中生有 原文只提到弱势群体 find it difficult to adopt dietary guidelines，并未让他们 Adopt a positive attitude towards dietary guidelines。 B) ✓ 正确 foods and recipes that are both inexpensive and nutritious ↔ Choose diets that are both healthy and affordable eating well on a budget ↔Choose diets that are both healthy and affordable 预判的"选择既健康又负担得起的饮食"与 Choose diets that are both healthy and affordable 是 both…and… 结构的整体同义改写。 C) 过度推断 原文只是说 The internet is full of recipes for "eating well on a budget."，是举例说 明网上有这类食谱，并非建议人们"必须" Make sure to purchase healthy foods on the internet。 D) 与原文相反 作者反复说明弱势群体的饮食问题不出在饮食习惯本身，而在经济与获取层面，Change their eating habits and consumption patterns 把矛头重新指向习惯，与全文立场 相悖。
